title: Diversity Digitized: Trapped in a Game
original_title: Diversity Digitized: Trapped in a Game
overview: Energetic street dance troupe Diversity have come a long way since winning BRITAIN’S GOT TALENT in 2009, as this live 2012 concert at London’s O2 Arena will prove. The show sees the group get stuck in a video game, and have to complete various levels to escape.
